definitions: the act of stopping something for a period of time
the act of officially preventing someone from doing their job, going to school, etc. for a period of time
a mixture in which small particles of a solid are spread throughout a liquid or gas
a system of springs and shock absorbers that supports the body of a vehicle and makes it more comfortable to ride in
examples: The project is currently in suspension.
He received a one-month suspension from work.
A suspension of chalk in water.
The car has a new suspension system.
